name: Ginger-Lime Chicken Skewers with Grape, Grapefruit & Avocado Salad
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Zest limes into a medium bowl (set limes aside for later use).
Peel and mince shallots; place half in the bowl with the lime zest (set remaining shallot aside).
Peel and grate or mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the lime zest along with mayo, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the marinade.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice limes into a large bowl. Add remaining shallot, oil, fish sauce, sugar, and Dijon; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, halve grapes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin and white pith from the grapefruits. Slice between the membranes to release segments; cut into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon. Add to the bowl along with the mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and skewers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
